samples: 12 train geometries; each batch: views 0,1,3,5, realization 0
mode: eval with gradients; frozen initial G and D; no optimizer
rule: lambda=floor(1000*min(1,0.1/median(r),0.25/max(r)))/1000 where r=norm(edge gradient)/norm(C1 gradient). Reject zero or nonfinite ratios or lambda=0.
rationale: Engineering gradient budget: target at most 10% of median baseline and 25% in any sampled batch. Not a physical acceptance tolerance or an optimal coefficient.
